copy.headline: BUILD THE OPENING TO LAST.

sections.evidence: Moon conjunct Saturn · exact today · approximately 1:18 pm AEST
sections.headline: Moon conjunct Saturn
sections.experience: Responsibility feels personal today. A limit, delay or duty may make the emotional weight feel larger than it is.
sections.meaning: Use discipline as containment, not punishment.
sections.move: Set one boundary. Complete one necessary task. Delay permanent emotional conclusions.

sections.evidence: Jupiter trine Saturn · major sky event
sections.headline: Jupiter trine Saturn
sections.experience: Jupiter creates room to grow while Saturn supplies the limit, sequence and structure that can make the growth sustainable.
sections.meaning: The opening can last, but the Mars–Saturn pressure warns that force and bad timing will waste it.
sections.move: Choose one expansion. Give it a boundary, budget and next step.

sections.evidence: Sun trine Moon · exact today · approximately 10:43 am AEST
sections.headline: Sun trine Moon
sections.experience: Your visible direction and emotional response are briefly supporting each other.
sections.meaning: Ease creates usable momentum, not a guaranteed result.
sections.move: Use the clear opening while action feels natural.

sections.evidence: Mars square Saturn · separating · 0.81° orb at closest approach
sections.headline: Mars square Saturn
sections.experience: More pressure will not repair bad timing.
sections.move: Change the method before adding effort.

sections.evidence: Moon conjunct Uranus · exact today · approximately 7:27 am AEST
sections.headline: Moon conjunct Uranus
sections.experience: An emotional reaction or sudden development can disrupt the expected rhythm.
sections.meaning: Freedom is useful. Impulse is not the same as direction.
sections.move: Pause before changing the plan. Keep the useful surprise.

sections.evidence: Moon square Mercury · exact today · approximately 7:29 am AEST
sections.headline: Moon square Mercury
sections.experience: What you feel and what was said are not producing the same conclusion.
sections.meaning: Irritation can identify the gap, but it cannot verify the interpretation.
sections.move: Check the message before sending the response.

sections.evidence: Venus trine True Node · applying · 2.37° orb at closest approach
sections.headline: Venus trine True Node
sections.experience: What you value and the direction developing ahead are moving with less resistance.
sections.meaning: Support is available, but it still needs a chosen destination.
sections.move: Put one relationship or value-led decision in motion.

copy.closing_rule: Use structure to protect the opportunity. Do not answer pressure with more force.
